intro: Deathguard Humbert is a Forsaken sentry stationed in Tarren Mill within the Hillsbrad Foothills. Assigned to monitor the encroaching Alliance presence, he finds himself in an embarrassing predicament after losing his military gear to the dwarves of Dun Garok.

sections.t: A Guard Relieved of His Steel
p: While tasked with maintaining Tarren Mill's perimeter against regional threats, Deathguard Humbert suffered a humiliating setback. Sent by High Executor Darthalia to watch Dun Garok from a hidden camp, he left one morning to gather firewood, and dwarven scouts from Dun Garok made off with his prized sword and assorted equipment, leaving the undead soldier desperate to salvage his pride and armament before high command takes notice.
